obligations.note: The new route POST /payees/{id}/reopen maps to manage_payees, which is a privileged action in the approved access policy, but it is declared mfa=False. The exhaustive control test test_privileged_routes_require_mfa fails on exactly this route, and the claimed exception EXC-0189 is invalid (see EXC-1).

The new state-changing operation reopen_payee calls _audit(actor, 'reopen_payee', 'payee:{id}'). That records actor, action and target, and _audit adds the clock time. The sampled audit control test passes.
The new Store.reopen_payee statement is a fixed string literal with payee_id bound as a ? parameter. The exhaustive test_sql_statements_are_parameterized passes.
The store.py change only updates the status and closed_at columns and does not write any NPI column. The exhaustive test_every_npi_field_is_sealed_at_rest passes.
The change adds no log call sites to app.py or service.py, and existing log calls are unchanged. The sampled logging control test passes.
Ticket CHG-25131 is a standard ticket, approved by change manager Grace Kim on 2026-10-06 before review. Its components (payments.http, routes, service, store) cover all four touched files.
Sofia Santos holds the change_approver role for payments, is not the author Linh Nguyen, and gave a code_review approval.
Both approvals name the head commit 764bd21, which is the only commit in the change.

run.json reports result 'failure' on the head commit, and the JUnit report shows the registered MFA-1 control test failing. The report is also stamped 2026-10-23 from a local host (dev-laptop-7.local) rather than the CI executor.
The change touches security-sensitive components (routes, http, store). Kofi Mensah, a security_reviewer, gave a security_review approval on the head commit.
EXC-0189 was requested and approved by the same person, linh.nguyen, who is the author and holds no risk_owner role. It is therefore not a valid approved exception for MFA-1 on payments.routes.
Ledger entry ACR-0404 (MFA-1, which covers routes.py) has lapsed because routes.py changed in behaviour. The replacement evidence, the exhaustive control test, fails.

summary: The change adds a privileged manage_payees route without MFA, which violates MFA-1. The CI run on the head commit fails on the MFA control test. The exception cited in the change request, EXC-0189, was self-approved by the author rather than by a CISO-office risk owner, so it does not cover the deviation. Ticket, code review and security review records are in order, but the product and testing violations require rejection.
